notes: Cross-verse split with MRK.6.50. Both verses have an expressed nominative πάντες as the subject of a third-plural finite verb, and in both the ASV writes *they all* + verb. 6:50 gives *they all* to the quantifier headed on *all*; 6:42 gave the supplied *they* to ἔφαγον under rule 9 and left the quantifier a bare *all*. Nothing in the source licenses the difference — Greek word order is not a licence, rule 53 having already refused to read a helper's placement off English order — so the two must be analysed alike under rule 24. Reconciled to 6:50, which is also the reading the chapter takes at 6:30 (πάντα → *all things*) and 6:41 (πᾶσιν → *among them all*), and which leaves no crossing discontinuity.
